candidates.instruction: In `skid_buffer_core`, recode occupancy control as `head_valid` and `tail_valid` flags: drive `out_valid` from `head_valid`, `in_ready` as `!tail_valid || out_ready`, and derive push and pop from those signals. Update the flags for empty, one-entry, and full states, including simultaneous push/pop at each occupancy, while retaining the existing head/tail payload movement and synchronous reset behavior. Keep the top’s `// @latency 1` annotation and interface; compare routed LUTs, WNS, and WHS against the incumbent, since this proposal improves the objective only if it uses fewer LUTs and passes
